document: Senior Fullstack Developer at WorldSkills (March 2020 - November 2020). WorldSkills organizes global vocational skills competitions. Built and modernized Angular 9 applications, migrating legacy AngularJS apps. Integrated with Java-based backends to ensure smooth data flow. Delivered responsive, user-friendly frontends for global competition tools.
